brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a plumbing service visit to repair a leaking pipe under the kitchen sink.
facts: A pipe under the kitchen sink has been leaking since yesterday.
Available for a technician visit on Thursday or Friday morning.
preferences: Prefers an early morning arrival window.
Willing to pay a standard diagnostic fee under 200 dollars.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, up to the not-to-exceed figure they quote

menuHints: The main menu offers new installations on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Plumbing. For new installations, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Automated Fallback
script.text: Your selection was not recognized. Please hold while we connect you to an operator.

script.label: Operator Greeting
script.text: Apex Plumbing front desk, this is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

script.label: Service Inquiry Response
script.text: I understand you need a technician out for a pipe repair.

script.label: Fee Quote
script.text: Just so you are aware, our standard diagnostic service visit is exactly 160 dollars.

script.label: Scheduling Limitation
script.text: I cannot book the appointment from the front desk, so I need to transfer you to our dispatch coordinator.

script.label: Transfer Initiation
script.text: Please hold for just a moment while I patch you through to scheduling.

script.label: Queue Message
script.text: You are being transferred to the scheduling queue. All dispatchers are currently on other calls.

script.label: System Failure Message
script.text: We apologize, but our appointment booking system is currently down for maintenance.

script.label: Call Termination
script.text: We cannot schedule visits at this time. Please call back tomorrow morning. Goodbye.

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
